Lexicon.dc:description: IWN-OMW is a new LMF version of the ItalWordNet resource converted and formatted according to the guidelines and requirements defined by the Open Multilingual Wordnet initiative (OMW, https://omwn.org/). This current version is derived from the ItalWordNet v.2. (IWN) database (http://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11752/ILC-62).
